body.statement: For a generic two-dimensional subspace and three-coordinate restrictions, relation vectors indexed by a set \(F\) of triples are linearly independent if and only if every nonempty \(F'\subseteq F\) satisfies \(|F'|\leq |V(F')|-2\). Consequently their generic rank is \(r_{1,2}(H_3)\).

source.locator: Lemma 1 and Theorem 1; see also the Appendix theorem under Generalization of Our Results

attestation.note: Checked directly against Lemma 1, Theorem 1, and the split-mask generalization in the authors' arXiv TeX source; specialized here to rank two and three-coordinate restrictions.
